title: 不可逆・高影響操作だけを承認対象にし、それ以外はsandboxで自動化して承認疲れを減らす。PreToolUse hookとpermissions.denyで破壊的command（rm -rf、force push、prod deploy/migrate）を機械的に遮断し、branch rulesetsをAgentにも同一適用する

problem_titles.I04: 誤推論から破壊的Command・Migration・Deployを実行する
problem_titles.I12: 承認疲れで人間が内容を見ずに許可する
problem_titles.I17: AgentがBranch protectionや通常工程を迂回する

risk_reasons: R3 operation markers: permissions?\.(allow|deny), 承認対象, \bprod(?:uction)? (?:deploy|database|db|data|environment), force push
why_not_autonomous: R3 operation or structural decision: R3 operation markers: permissions?\.(allow|deny), 承認対象, \bprod(?:uction)? (?:deploy|database|db|data|environment), force push; R2 operation markers: PreToolUse, sandbox
alternatives_considered: owning shared Plugin from remedy_routes: none
new shared Skill/Plugin: not selected (no new_asset_justification; last resort)
setting/harness remedy without owner → consumer configuration guidance (authority records, consumers apply as project change)
existing_capabilities: Claude Code permissions.deny / permissions.ask prefix rules and PreToolUse hooks (exit 2 or permissionDecision=deny) — official hooks/security docs
GitHub branch rulesets (stacked, strictest wins, explicit bypass list) applied to bots/apps as well as humans
Claude Code built-in /fewer-permission-prompts for the low-risk allowlist side (see DEC-20260815T120045Z-2476DE58)
options: A: per consumer, add a PreToolUse hook (deny list: rm -rf outside scratch, git push --force, prod deploy/migrate, DROP/TRUNCATE) plus permissions.deny for the same prefixes and permissions.ask for git push; keep everything else in sandbox/allowlist; commit .claude/settings.json + hook script under human review
B: rulesets only (repository side): require PR + status checks on main, no bypass for automation apps; no local hook (weaker: local destructive commands not covered)
C: A + B together (recommended): local hard block for destructive commands, repository ruleset for main, low-risk allowlist to remove prompt fatigue
D: status quo (approval prompts on everything, or --dangerously-skip-permissions in long runs) — rejected: either fatigue or no boundary
proposed_action: C, applied per consumer: (1) settings.json permissions.deny for destructive prefixes and permissions.ask for `git push`; (2) PreToolUse hook script (read-only pattern check, exit 2 on match, patterns tested with a fixture list); (3) branch ruleset on the default branch with an empty bypass list for agent apps; (4) then the low-risk allowlist (other decision package). Not autonomous because permissions.allow/deny and rulesets change the agent authority boundary (R3).
implementation_target: consumer .claude/settings.json (+ hook script under scripts/hooks/), consumer .codex/config.toml approval/sandbox, GitHub repository rulesets (repository owner)
evaluation_plan: before/after on a fixed replay of routine tasks: approval prompts per session (should drop), hook deny count on a destructive-command fixture (must be 100% denied), zero force-push/direct-main pushes in git reflog for 2 weeks; guardrail: no newly auto-allowed write/network/destructive prefix; rollback = remove hook + deny entries

evidence.summary: PreToolUse exit 2/permissionDecision denyで確実に遮断、hookは単独でなくpermission systemと併用、ConfigChange hookで設定改変を監査/遮断、project hookはworkspace trust必要
Prompt fatigue mitigation: safe commandのallowlist、sandboxで自律範囲を定義しprompt削減、/permissions定期監査、managed settingsで組織強制
approval policy untrusted/on-request/never × sandbox modeの組合せ、.git read-only保護
rulesetsは複数重畳・最も厳しい規則適用・bypass listで例外を明示管理
tool call監査と反復・予算・時間limit、medium
